name: India Pesticides Ltd
tagline: R&D-driven agrochemical technical/API maker with a genuine margin-recovery signal from a trusted tracker, clouded by a 2024 tax-evasion raid
business_overview: India Pesticides (IPL) manufactures agrochemical technicals, APIs and formulations, with revenue concentrated in a few molecules (Folpet, Captan and others -- ~45% of revenue per management) and an expanding PEDA production line.
fundamentals_narrative: Moderate-quality small-cap agrochemical company with above-industry-median revenue CAGR and reasonable ROCE. Sales were volatile 2023-2024 (a bad FY23Q4 with -8% sales and -63% EPS) before recovering.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 68 posts (single batch, spanning Jan 2023-May 2026, no escalation needed). harsh.beria93 (trusted) has tracked this stock closely and repeatedly with well-received concall notes (loves of 17, 16, 10) through multiple cycles -- a bad FY23Q4 (sales -8%, EPS -63%), recovery through 2024, and as recently as 1 Jan 2026 noting 'good growth in sales along with margin recovery' over the last few quarters. A serious governance overhang emerged Dec 2024: an Income Tax raid on the registered office over an alleged ~Rs 300 Cr tax-evasion matter. Most recent 2026 posts discuss competitive risk (Aarti Industries entering the same PEDA molecule with a potential backward-integration cost advantage) and a nationwide Paraquat ban (IPL product exposure unclear from the thread).
